verdict.rationale: Compliance certifications and data residency are a fair question for a SaaS AI voice platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2, or data-residency options. Data-retention deletion and consent-conditional recording are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options
